description: Code-behind for the StartExam page, managing exam initialization, course selection based on user semester, and exam session control for an online examination system.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam ASP.NET page, handling user session, course loading based on semester, and initiating exams.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; checks user login, retrieves user semester info, and populates course dropdown accordingly.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Handler for course selection, currently empty.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Starts the selected exam (Theory or MCQ) after checking database for available questions, and sets session variables for exam.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handler for semester dropdown change, currently empty.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handler for course dropdown change, currently empty.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user by redirecting to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a theory exam in GridView, checks if already taken, if not sets question number and transfers to exam page.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of an MCQ exam in GridView, similar logic to theory exam handler.
